deriv_discontinuity.reproduce: docs/derivations/crb_tcp_center.md, Sec. (b), 'Por que hay una discontinuidad en r=0'
deriv_discontinuity.statement: The central Fisher term tends to (beta/N) r_hat r_hat^T, which has no matrix limit at r=0; sqrt(p_center) ~ |r| is a cone, so CR regularity fails at r=0

deriv_limit.statement: r->0 limit of the centre CRB without background: sigma_lim^2 = L^2/(8 N g^2) (3g^2+e^x)/(3g^2+2e^x), direction independent; ratio to S27 = 2/sqrt5 for a quadratic zero; limit ellipse axes (alpha+beta)^-1/2 and alpha^-1/2

deriv_master_formula.statement: Master formula F = 6 N R^2 h'_R^2 / (h_R (3 h_R + h_0)) * Id for the Fisher information at the centre of the TCP for any radial beam whose central term vanishes at the origin; closed forms of Appendix A

deriv_multiphoton.statement: With multiphoton exponent c the centre point value is L g^-1/(2 c sqrt(2N)) and the limit equals the point value for c>1

deriv_noncommuting.statement: With finite SBR the centre CRB is continuous and equals Eq. S31; the limits SBR->inf and r->0 do not commute; transition radius r_c = (sqrt3 L/4) e^{-x/2}/sqrt(SBR) (leading order)

deriv_pedestal.statement: A constant pedestal eps is exactly a background with SBR_eps = 3 e x e^{-x}/(4 eps); a Gaussian pedestal is not equivalent to a background (closed form F_eps/F_pt); the two agree to first order in eps up to relative O(x^2)

eps0_crb_divergence_L_nm.statement: with eps=0 the centre CRB diverges at L = fwhm/sqrt(ln2) (ring diameter); monotonic only for smaller L

fwhm_masullo_nm.statement: fwhm that reproduces the Masullo table

fwhm_nm.statement: LG donut size parameter fwhm (Balzarotti Eq. S17); ring peak-to-peak diameter fwhm/sqrt(ln2)

lit_balzarotti_zero_depth.statement: In the MINFLUX experiments the donut minimum was below 0.2% of the ring maximum

lit_masullo_table.reproduce: Masullo, Lopez, Stefani, Biophys. Rep. 2 (2022), Supplemental Information p. 9 (transcribed in docs/literature/A_minflux_theory.md, Sec. 8.2 check 4)
lit_masullo_table.statement: Published MINFLUX centre precision 0.94 / 1.96 / 3.16 nm for L = 50 / 100 / 150 nm (Supplementary Table 1, column 2, 'precision at the center'); the legend states no SBR or N for this column: SBR=5, N=500 and fwhm=360 nm are inferred by us from the other columns

lit_simuflux_crb_point_value.reproduce: Marin & Ries (2026), Fig. 2e and Supplementary Fig. 8 (sigma_CRB ~ 2.8 nm at N=100, ~0.9 nm at N=1000, read from the plots); public code calculateCRBdirect (finite differences, p_i + 1e-4 regularizer); comparison in docs/literature/C_insilico_vs_donutloc.md, Sec. 1a

lit_simuflux_mask_misalignment.statement: A shift of the vortex phase mask deforms the donut and fills the zero; SimuFLUX finds a z-dependent bias and an rmse up to ~20 times the aligned CRB, not reflected by the CRB

lit_simuflux_power_ramp.reproduce: Marin & Ries, Nat. Commun. 17, 246 (2026), public code ries-lab/SimuFLUX, example sequences Tracking_2D / Imaging_2D (pwrFactor 1,1,2,3 and 1,1,2,4,6); docs/literature/C_insilico_minflux.md, Sec. on iterative sequences
